messages:
anya: Heads-up: saw increasing tail latency on /chat-stream for long sessions. Profiling indicates KV cache TTLs drifting and kernel selection flipping to 'fallback' mid-session. Snapshot attached.

matt: Can you paste the top-line numbers? p95/p99, kv hit ratio?

anya: p50 120ms p95 960ms p99 1.8s for affected sessions. KV hit ratio dropped from 98% -> 72% over 30m. Kernel fallback rate rose from 0.5% -> 6%.

jen: ops-bot just opened alert: `KV_STALENESS_BURNRATE` triggered on prod-us-west. Anyone oncall?

ops-bot: Incident created: #INC-4729 first detection 1766254325. Paging: if burn rate > 1.5 for 10m escalate.

rao: Query I used to verify (Prometheus):
```
avg_over_time(token_latency_seconds{route="/chat-stream"}[30m])
max_over_time(histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(token_latency_bucket[5m])) by (le, route))[30m])
sum(rate(kv_cache_miss_total[5m])) by (route) / sum(rate(kv_cache_request_total[5m])) by (route)
```

anya: Also looked at kernel selection logs — binder shows rapid kernel thresholds crossing when kv miss spikes. snippet:
```
kernel_select: route=/chat-stream session_id=... selected=slow_kernel reason=kv_miss_rate>0.04
```

kevin: hypothesis: our sampler for kernel performance metrics is biased by warm-start sessions and misses slow drift. We should sample at session-level and include 'kv_ttl_age' histogram in dashboard.

matt: Agreed. For dashboards: new panel for 'kv_ttl_age' and 'kernel_switch_rate' per-route + correlate with token tail latency. Propose alert change: use burn-rate on p95 token latency but smooth with ewm alpha=0.2 and require kv_miss_ratio > 0.05 to avoid noisy pages.

jen: I can update dashboard and create a canary alert rule. Pager only if both conditions hold for 5m. Otherwise send slack notification.

anya: Action items:
- @jen add `kv_ttl_age` panel + kernel_switch_rate (due EOD) 
- @rao add PromQL for session-sampled p95 and push to alerts (tomorrow)
- @kevin add opt sampler to runtime to tag session-level metrics (blocker for root cause)

matt: Also add a short playbook note for SRE: steps to clear KV cache per-route and rollback kernel threshold change.

jen: I'll update playbook and attach runbook snippets in the incident.

anya: Thanks. tagging @ops-bot to keep incident open until metrics stabilize.

ops-bot: Incident INC-4729 updated: status=investigating, owner=jen.

kevin: Quick note — rolling back the last kernel threshold change (PR #542) removed the fallback but didn't fix kv drift; seems TTL management is the main vector.

anya: Will follow up with a profiling trace and small heap of logs. Posting link: https://profiler.internal/runs/1766254310

matt: Good catch. keep updates here.
